neighbours.label: Descriptions of hypothetical, simulated or preliminary representations rather than realized objects
fire: The engineers tested a prototype vehicle before beginning production.
The biologists examined artificial ponds under controlled laboratory conditions.
The team compared the virtual results with measurements from the tunnel.
The astronomer presented a theoretical finding about the rotating star.
The report gives approximations of the number of damaged buildings.
The study used a simulated city to evaluate the traffic rules.
The account describes an imagined traveler arriving in a distant village.
The scientists predicted the outcome before the experiment began.
quiet: The engineers tested a production vehicle before beginning delivery.
The biologists examined natural ponds under ordinary outdoor conditions.
The team compared the recorded results with measurements from the tunnel.
The astronomer presented an observational finding about the rotating star.
The report gives exact counts of the number of damaged buildings.
The study used a real city to evaluate the traffic rules.
The account describes an actual traveler arriving in a distant village.
The scientists recorded the outcome after the experiment ended.

notes: Weak negative pole with mixed gate regimes; prototype, artificial, virtual and theoretical are suggestive, but not a settled feature. No exploratory scoring; no downloaded band scan covers this unit. Sentences written by Codex.
